scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M resident-T16 D8 selected gate/up direct per-column wave decode on gfx1151

repo.qualification: Candidate measurements were made in the implementation worktree; clean selector-unset production publication remains required.

candidate.mapping: four wave32 groups each own one output column per lane and all 32 routed rows
candidate.weight_path: each lane directly decodes its resident-T16 Q4 column; no adjacent-column pair decode and no wave shuffle
candidate.arithmetic: unchanged split16 packed dots, K32 accumulation order, and BF16 output
candidate.resident_layout: unchanged T16; no sidecar or transpose

validation.red: The direct-decode fixture failed on the missing direct_wave_decode wrapper ABI.
validation.primitive_green: All nine Q4 configurations passed the independent CPU-reference quality gate; the direct candidate is BF16-byte identical to pair-decode production.
validation.affected_bundle: The complete changed kernel/runtime/backend/category/publication bundle passed with two expected skips.

leaf.scope: actual layer-1 gate/up weights and frozen natural pp512 routing; BF16-to-D8 pack included; nine counter-rotated burst-three samples

full_model.scope: one resident owner; matrix512/attention128; one 128-row warmup per mode; seven paired synchronized pp512 repetitions

trace.scope: cached focused CPU-reference fixture under rocprofv3
trace.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-q4-direct-wavecols-trace --output-file q4-direct-wavecols -- .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q 'tests/test_gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill.py::test_q4_k_t16_ds4_f32_mmq64x32_matches_cpu_quality_gate[1-True-True-True-False-True]'

decision.action: Promote direct per-column Q4 wave decode as the gfx1151 candidate default; retain pair decode as explicit rollback through clean selector-unset production publication.
